text.tspan: ATT&CK technique coverage heatmap built from the 909 non-AWS detection use cases in github.com/aguztynbassi/SID (Windows, Network Devices, Cloud/IaaS, Cloud/Office Suite, Cloud/SaaS, Linux, macOS, ESXi, PRE). Color reflects the highest severity among every use case that maps to a technique: purple = Critical, red = High, blue = Medium, yellow = Low. Only ~20% of source cases carry an explicit severity tag; the rest were inferred from MITRE tactic and threat-specific keywords

- each technique's comment and metadata state how many contributing cases were explicit vs. inferred, so you can judge confidence per cell. Built against the official ATT&CK v19.0 STIX data: note that 'Defense Evasion' (TA0005) no longer exists as a tactic in v19 - it was split into 'Stealth' and 'Defense Impairment', and techniques like T1562/Impair Defenses were revoked in favor of T1685/Disable or Modify Tools. All technique IDs here are current, non-revoked v19 IDs.
IaaS, Linux, macOS, SaaS, ESXi, Network Devices, PRE, Containers, Office Suite, Identity Provider
Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
Disable or Modify Linux Audit System Log
Disable or Modify Windows Event Log
